Windows XP brings an unmistakable wave of early-2000s nostalgia to your developer portfolio, faithfully recreating the iconic Bliss desktop environment complete with taskbar, start menu, and windowed content panels. Every interaction mirrors the operating system that defined a generation of computer users. This theme is ideal for developers who want to make a memorable, humour-forward first impression while still presenting serious professional work.

## Theme Overview

Windows XP transforms your portfolio into a living replica of Microsoft's most beloved operating system. The layout anchors a classic taskbar along the bottom of the screen, while your bio, projects, and skills surface inside individual floating windows — each with the signature blue title bar, minimize/maximize/close buttons, and bevelled chrome that defined the XP era. Desktop icons serve as navigation shortcuts, and the overall colour palette of sky blue, green hillside wallpaper, and silver controls makes the nostalgia immediate and undeniable. Typography leans into the era's system-font conventions, reinforcing the illusion at every turn.

## Design Highlights

- Faithful recreation of the Windows XP desktop environment with taskbar and Start button
- Floating draggable content windows with authentic XP title-bar chrome and control buttons
- Desktop icon navigation for projects, about, and contact sections
- Iconic blue-sky and green-field Bliss wallpaper aesthetic throughout
- System-era typography and bevelled UI controls that complete the OS illusion

## Who This Theme Suits

Windows XP is perfect for developers, engineers, and creative technologists who grew up with XP and want their portfolio to reflect both personality and technical craft. It works especially well for those in gaming, web history, or retro-tech spaces where nostalgia is a strength rather than a quirk — and for anyone who wants visitors to remember their site long after they've closed the tab.
